name: supervisorSubordinateTrainingNeedApplication
description: Lets a Supervisor submit a training need application on behalf of one or more direct reports at once, or just list them when subordinates is omitted (answers 'who are my subordinates?' without submitting anything). Once subordinates is given, validates each against the live direct-report list FIRST. Once confirmed, identify the need; objective, relevance to job, benefit to employee, and benefit to company are collected only if the server demands them - mandatoriness is a per-client config, never assumed. On every turn the user attaches a file, call this tool on that same turn (the chat passes a file's contents only then); files are added (several allowed) if they match PeoplesHR's allowed types and size - take one off with removeAttachments, or swap with replaceAttachments. Call with confirmed unset first for a preview and the real confirmation prompt, then again with confirmed:true, before anything is validated or saved. Write tool - submits real applications, one per selected subordinate, on success.
taskName: Submitting a Training Need Application (Supervisor, for Subordinates)
